title: Austin Leaders Discuss State Funding Impact
summary:
*   Austin area officials and state delegates convened to discuss crucial financial challenges impacting the region.
*   The meeting brought together state representatives, city leaders, county judges, commissioners, and school superintendents.
*   Key discussion points focused on the effects of state revenue caps and school finance funding on the Austin region.
*   This gathering was strictly for discussion and information exchange; no formal actions or decisions were made.
